urgentHelp: If you're in a very dark place right now, please don't wait for our next session. You can call the SADAG Suicide Crisis Helpline on 0800 567 567 any time, day or night, and it's free. If you or someone else is in immediate danger, call 112 from your cellphone. I'm not an emergency service, but support is out there, and you deserve it.
